title: Healthcare NPPES Authorized Official versus LOCATION contact contrast
hypothesis: An active primary-taxonomy NPPES NPI-2 record can establish practice identity. AO and LOCATION telephones are distinct published business-contact fields; their equality or difference is a source contrast only and never proves ownership, direct reach, handset ownership, mobile status, or delivery eligibility.
ownerSource: NPPES Authorized Official identity and title are role-candidate evidence only. An owner-supported label requires independent current owner/founder corroboration and an explicit direct-business-contact link to the same published contact.
phoneSource: NPPES LOCATION telephone is the proposed published practice-contact field. Preserve AO telephone separately as nppes_ao_published metadata; do not promote AO-only, equal, or different phone fields into an owner contact, private-contact, or handset claim.

workflow.label: NPPES NPI-2 organization
workflow.detail: Read the free public organization record and retain AO and LOCATION source fields separately.

workflow.label: Active primary-taxonomy role gate
workflow.detail: Require active status, requested primary taxonomy, person AO, and no explicit staff-title exclusion.

workflow.label: Source-row hold
workflow.detail: Hold inactive, taxonomy-mismatched, missing-person, or explicit staff-title records.

workflow.label: AO and LOCATION provenance
workflow.detail: Record each field as published AO or LOCATION evidence. Same/different values remain source contrast only.

workflow.label: AO-only or no-LOCATION hold
workflow.detail: Hold rows without a published LOCATION field from the public practice-contact lane.

workflow.label: Published practice-contact candidate
workflow.detail: Use LOCATION only as a business-contact candidate; AO remains unproven role metadata.

workflow.label: Corporate and repeated-AO gate
workflow.detail: Hold corporate/DSO and AO identity-plus-phone repetition pending independent ownership evidence.

workflow.label: Corporate/repeated-AO hold
workflow.detail: Do not label corporate or repeated-AO records as independent owner contacts.

workflow.label: Contact and compliance gates
workflow.detail: Apply authorized line-type, reachability, DNC/TCPA, suppression, duplicate, freshness, and timezone gates to the published practice contact.

workflow.label: Contact-gate hold
workflow.detail: Hold or drop any nonqualifying business-contact candidate with its actual gate reason.

workflow.label: Independent owner/direct-link evidence
workflow.detail: Require current business-site direct-contact evidence plus independent owner/founder corroboration for an owner-supported label.

workflow.label: Business contact only
workflow.detail: Retain only the business-contact classification when ownership or direct link is unresolved.

workflow.label: Owner-supported delivery
workflow.detail: Deliver only after independent owner/direct-link evidence and all contact/compliance gates support the stated classification.

edges.label: inactive, mismatch, staff, or no person

failures.risk: Different AO and LOCATION or Maps numbers are labelled direct owner lines.
failures.mitigation: Persist field provenance and treat equality/difference as contrast only; never set owner evidence from bucket assignment.

failures.risk: A LOCATION-only public practice line is dropped while AO-only data becomes the job phone.
failures.mitigation: Select LOCATION for the public practice-contact lane and hold AO-only/no-LOCATION rows.

failures.risk: Staff, corporate, DSO, or repeated-AO records are treated as independent owner contacts.
failures.mitigation: Keep staff-title exclusion and add corporate plus normalized AO identity-and-phone repetition holds before owner labelling.

failures.risk: A verified mobile is delivered with an owner implication without independent ownership evidence.
failures.mitigation: Call assessOwnerEvidence and hold unresolved rows before owner-supported delivery.

failures.risk: Mailing, parcel, residential, trace, or append data discovers an unpublished contact.
failures.mitigation: Keep this source-specific route to published NPPES fields and hold missing field cases.

sources.label: NPPES NPI-2 register adapter
sources.scope: Free public active NPI-2 source filtered by requested taxonomy; parser retains AO identity/title/phone and LOCATION phone.

sources.label: NPPES source catalogue
sources.scope: Documents AO telephone as person or HQ desk and LOCATION telephone as practice contact, with free keyless access.
sources.reference: handoff/04_SOURCE_CATALOG.md Group C, NPPES NPI Registry API

sources.label: Healthcare contrast brain entry
sources.scope: Recipe D historical identity study; its 682 rows are not verified-phone or clean-contact outcomes.

sources.label: Independent owner evidence gate
sources.scope: Current business-site direct-contact evidence plus distinct registry owner/founder corroboration.

iterations.hypothesis: An AO/Maps mismatch can be represented as a direct owner-line candidate in recipe D.
iterations.test: Five synthetic NPI-2 parser cases on 2026-09-24: same AO/LOCATION field, different fields, LOCATION-only, Billing Coordinator AO, and corporate-looking Vice President AO.
iterations.observed: Same and different cases both kept AO phone as phone10; LOCATION-only kept with phone10 null despite payload location_phone; staff title held; corporate-like case kept. The existing bucket label calls any unequal register/Maps phone a direct line candidate without field provenance or owner assessment.
iterations.change: Create a source-specific NPPES healthcare field-provenance lane: LOCATION-only public practice contact, AO-only hold, equality/difference contrast only, corporate/repeated-AO hold, and assessOwnerEvidence before owner-supported delivery.

measurement.result: Five synthetic local NPPES parser cases measured AO/LOCATION field handling only: same and different field rows kept with AO phone as primary; LOCATION-only had null primary phone; explicit staff title rejected; corporate-like AO kept. No network, paid provider, lookup, phone verification, ownership determination, reachability, DNC/TCPA check, or delivery occurred.

cost.basis: Local five-case code audit; NPPES public source is free
cost.note: No clean, owner-supported, or delivered contact outcome was measured. The live brain's identity-study denominator is distinct from a clean-contact denominator.

implementation.summary: NPPES parser has active, primary-taxonomy, and explicit staff-title gates, but stores AO phone as phone10 and LOCATION only in payload. Recipe-D bucketing labels unequal Maps phone as direct-line candidate; corporate/repeated-AO and independent owner/direct-link gates are absent from settlement.

nextMeasurement: After the correction, run five synthetic route fixtures for same, different, LOCATION-only, AO-only, and staff/corporate-repeated cases. Assert that only LOCATION enters public practice-contact gates, AO contrast never sets an owner-direct flag, AO-only/corporate/repeated rows hold, and assessOwnerEvidence gates any owner label. Then conduct a lawful aggregate 5-20 row public NPPES observation with separate source, field, hold, contact-gate, owner-evidence, and delivery denominators.
